statement_summary: Security program covers every CUI and FCI system
CUI only on SSP-listed systems; SSP updated before changes
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual SP 800-171A self-assessment with outside review before each SPRS entry
Every unmet requirement on the POA&M; monthly review
No SPRS score or affirmation without supporting evidence
Separation of duties recorded as an enduring exception with outside review
Only approved external systems; cloud for CUI must be FedRAMP Moderate or equivalent
No CUI to anyone but Prime A without flowdown and approval
Helpers on site only; no remote-support tool; helper accounts removed the day work ends
Check public posts against CUI markings and Prime A approval
Standard user account for daily work
MFA on every CUI and FCI service and laptop admin sign-in; hardware keys in SYS-10
Password manager; no passwords in files; default passwords changed
Lockout, CUI notice, and screen lock
CUI only on the laptop; phone for MFA and non-CUI email
Monthly review of sign-ins, downloads, laptop and router logs
FIPS-validated encryption on every CUI device and medium; keys kept apart
CUI only through the portal or SYS-10
Only the encrypted backup drive; kept in the home safe
Weekly backup; quarterly restore test; version history
Locked cabinet; shredding; SP 800-88 Rev. 2 sanitization with a record
No export-controlled data to foreign persons; carve-out conditions for storage
Office locked when others are home; key control
Visitor escort and visitor log kept one year
Business network separate from household devices; UPnP and remote admin off
No CUI, FCI, or NDA data in commercial AI tools
Updates within 30 days; alerts subscription; monthly vulnerability scan
Annual awareness, CUI handling, and insider threat training
Same-day incident log with discovery time
DoD report within 72 hours; incident number to Prime A
Preserve images 90 days; malware only to DC3
Export counsel decides on voluntary disclosure
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Continuity arrangement with Prime A; sealed recovery codes
